command: npm run verify:e2e (all Playwright projects, own server on a free port, one worker)

fullSuite.note: Skips are the existing per-project gating. Two earlier full runs on the same source each lost tests that pass alone: the 40-student 320 px/200% crew layout and the denied-microphone dictation alert (first run), and WebKit phone Back after saving a Valutazioni note (second run). Each passed in isolation (6 of 6 and 6 of 6 repeats); F4 changes no navigation, evaluation or speech file. The third run, recorded here, is clean.

the floating Salva immagine button saves a PNG whose width is the content's CSS width times the device pixel ratio and whose height covers every group of a 13-crew course

the PNG matches Playwright's own screenshot of the same content (mean greyscale difference within 2.5, under 1.2% of pixels off, block colour within 2.2), and a blank, a 6 px shifted and a greyscale image are rejected on every run

offline, after a width change forces a new render, the boat logos are still in the image

WebKit makes the image with the logos (download path: Playwright WebKit has no navigator.share)

the Comandate summary saves an image of the screen from the same floating button
